svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. The assistant can answer directly or use the connected database. For a data question it drafts SQL from the question and table list, checks the query, executes exactly the checked SQL with read-only access, and optionally explains all loaded rows, up to 1,000. Query errors fail the turn, while an explanation-only failure can preserve the table.
svg.title: AI query assistant — decide, query, and explain
